big: Two parties agree today to trade the Nifty at a fixed price one month from now. No shares change hands today. That agreement is a futures contract. Learn its parts before you go near one.

lines: So a futures contract is a promise?
A standardised promise on an exchange. Its value comes from an underlying asset, so it is a derivative. It has a fixed lot size and an expiry date. After expiry, the contract no longer exists.

alt: Three boxes: underlying, lot size, expiry
caps: Value comes from an underlying asset.
Each contract has a fixed lot size.
It ends on an expiry date.
After expiry, it no longer exists.
